messages.subject: ggplot2 memory problem?
parts:
Decidedly I am not having good luck with R ggplot2 these last few days. I was playing around with the dataset flights in nycflight13 library trying ggplot2 geom_bar with different settings and ran into problems. After three plots and attempting a 4th one R crashes with a fatal error. This happened several times and one time there was an error message which I captured.
I am running R 4.0.1 ggplot2 version 3.3.1. My machine is Lenovo IdeaPad Flex with 16GB RAM, GPU, Intel processor i7 8th Gen. I am running Ubuntu 20.04 on this machine -- no dual boot. I am surprised that I am running into memory issues. Is this a common problem? How can I fix it and if memory allocation to R is the issue how can I find the size allocated and how can increase it. Again I am running Ubuntu 20.04 so windows commands do not work.

Hello Aref,
I believe you are trying to plot 350.000 elements unintentionally
one way you can go for is apply the aggregation, observe the data-set and last, plot it

library(nycflights13)
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)

 
dataPlot <- data.table(flights)[, .N, by = c("origin", "dest")]
ggplot(dataPlot, aes(dest, N, fill = origin)) + geom_col() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
